name: comparator-night-light
prompt: Build a night light: a photoresistor senses darkness and a comparator turns an LED on when it gets dark. Use a 5 V supply, with the comparison threshold set at half the supply by a resistive reference divider.
notes: Sensor divider into one comparator input, reference divider into the other, LED on the output. The 2.5 V threshold is asserted via the accuracy checker (reference divider ratio 0.5), not the gates.
